overview_description.description: Nav Technologies provides financial management tools that help small businesses access credit and financing opportunities. The company offers a platform where users can monitor and understand their business credit profiles, match with financing options, and receive insights to improve creditworthiness. Nav Technologies integrates with bank accounts, accounting software, and credit bureaus to offer tailored recommendations based on a business’s financial data. The platform allows businesses to compare credit cards, loans, and other financial products suited to their needs. Nav also offers identity protection features, alerts for changes in credit reports, and educational content to support informed financial decisions. The company aims to streamline how small businesses manage credit and find funding options through data-driven tools and transparency.

about_short_description.short_description: Nav is a credit and financial health platform that provides access to credit and financing opportunities for businesses.

product.name: Nav
product.description: A digital platform that helps small businesses monitor credit, manage cash flow, assess funding readiness, and identify financing options.

product.name: Nav Prime
product.description: A paid membership that provides expanded credit reports, business-credit-building tradelines, bookkeeping tools, funding-readiness insights, and optional business credit coaching.

product.name: Credit Health
product.description: A credit-monitoring service that consolidates business and personal credit information, scores, reports, alerts, and factors affecting credit standing.

product.name: Cash Flow Health
product.description: A cash-flow management and bookkeeping service for connecting accounts, tracking balances, categorizing transactions, forecasting cash flow, and preparing financial reports.

product.name: Funding Readiness and Financing Marketplace
product.description: A service that evaluates business funding readiness and presents financing opportunities from third-party lending partners based on business and personal financial information.

product.name: Business Credit Coaching
product.description: A one-on-one guidance service that helps business owners interpret credit information, establish business credit, and plan actions to improve funding readiness.
